episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: When her father is murdered, Ana moves to Galicia to lead her own investigation into his past. Soon she meets Daniel, the heir to a drug empire.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: The Padíns want to keep young Marco out of their business. After making a deal with Daniel, Ana begins digging into his numerous shady enterprises.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Ana goes on a fancy business trip with Daniel and has a rocky encounter with José Padín. The relationship between Marco and María worries the clan.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: Samuel's release heightens tensions and intensifies police investigations. Ana assists the clan's next operation while keeping her true plan in mind.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: José Padín is accidentally thrust back into the spotlight. A shooting disrupts the town and forces Ana to undertake a mission on Daniel's behalf.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: While Daniel involves Ana in his future plans, Nazario pokes around the lawyer's past. The Padíns discover that there's a snitch among them.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.summary: It's all set for the big operation. As secrets continue to unfold, Ana is thrown into turmoil in an attempt to warn Daniel before it's too late.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: After four years in prison, Daniel returns to Cambados, where new rivals threaten his father's empire. Ana gets a chance to reclaim her life.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: Back from abroad, Ana returns to Galicia on business. Daniel approaches his godson. The Padíns get into deep water during a highly anticipated drop.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Berta must confront a secret from her past. As Padín's suspicions grow, Nilo tries to sniff out a rat. Daniel takes a big risk by meeting his daughter.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: Toño worms his way into the rival gang as the police make an arrest. A desperate Ana asks Daniel for help before receiving a call from the hospital.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: Tensions rise as Paco and Padín struggle for control. Laura tries to help Ana on a risky mission, while Toño leads the clan — with police on their tail.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: Marco takes to the stand and clan rivalries come to a head. Ana feels pressure to tell all, but her future with Daniel hinges on an impossible choice.
